about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS DEMO

Dive into the captivating world of neon puzzles with the Network Nodes demo!

This demo gives you access to the first levels of the game, showcasing the core mechanics:

  • Connect nodes while respecting their required number of connections

  • Avoid line intersections and navigate around obstacles

  • Test your logical thinking with increasingly challenging puzzles

  • Enjoy the atmospheric neon design and smooth animations

Each node requires a specific number of connections — no more, no less. Connect them all correctly to solve the level and unlock the next challenge!

WHAT'S IN THE FULL GAME

  • 10+ unique levels of gradually increasing difficulty

  • Colored nodes with special connection rules

  • Phased activation — unlock new nodes by creating the right connections

  • Advanced obstacles requiring strategic planning

  • Save system to track your progress

  • Achievements and leaderboards

We value your feedback!

Please leave a review of the demo — your comments will help us make the full version of the game even better!

Add the game to your wishlist to receive development updates and be notified when the full version releases!
